---
title: "Psychedelic Experience"
date: 2023-04-25
---

There was a sense of knowing stronger than anything I had felt before. It began with mild anxiety. I tried to ignore it. Then the blanket became dancing animals.

I was in bed between two dark curtains. A lighter curtain in the middle let in enough light to make me want to look outside, but I could not, or it no longer seemed important.

Drinking water became an engineering problem. I pulled the bottle toward me, opened it, held the top, and lifted the bottom. I had to push the bottle down with my mouth to tilt it. I had the strength of a two-year-old.

My chest began moving vigorously back and forth, as if I were possessed. The movement felt both voluntary and compelled. I was not scared, only surprised. Soon it was accompanied by hysterical laughter.

Then came more realizations than I could process. Whether any were true, I cannot say. The certainty was part of the experience. It felt as if my mind were expanding faster than it could represent what was happening.
